build_summary: 3.29 Scion Reliquarian Herald of Thunder autobomber theory build. Treat as a project build until patch notes, PoB data, and in-game Herald/Shock behavior are confirmed.
strengths: Directly targets the Reliquarian Herald/Shock research branch.
Low-input mapping goal once the Herald loop works.
Blight of Contagion fallback keeps the same Scion character usable if the autobomber fails.
weaknesses: Not a clean league starter until Storm Secret price and self-damage are known.
Guardian maps depend on boss shock uptime, not only map clear speed.
Delve/Fossil requires recovery and mitigation checks before pushing depth.

danger_zones: Do not equip Storm Secret and push red maps before recovery is proven.
Do not use Elemental Focus in the main Herald link unless shock is maintained by another skill.
Do not mark Guardian farming ready from mapping clear speed alone.
Do not deep Delve until degens, darkness, and rare damage are tested.
farming_strategy: Early maps: Atlas completion, Kirac, Essence, Harvest, Betrayal. Mid maps: Blight/Expedition/Harvest and shallow Delve/Fossil if deaths are rare. Guardian maps only after boss shock uptime and Storm Secret recovery are proven. If the Herald loop fails, pivot to Blight of Contagion and farm Expedition/Harvest/Blight/Fossil instead of forcing speed mechanics.
